title: Duplicated remote account JSON construction
description: src/interactions.rs:323-347, 381-405, 743-771. Three places construct remote account JSON with the same 20-field json!() macro: followers_list, following_list, and follow_requests. This should be a shared function like remote_account_to_json() that takes (id, username, domain, display_name, bio_html) and returns the JSON. Would also make it easier to fix the hardcoded created_at of 1970-01-01 when actual timestamps become available.
